Our work on aggregate data (AD) and causally interpretable meta-analysis has recently been published in Biometrics and JRSSA. The Biometrics paper discusses how to transport individual participant data (IPD) from a source study to a target population for which only AD are available. The latter paper addresses the transportability of a source study with AD to a target population also characterized by AD, by leveraging IPD from another trial in the evidence pool.

![](/files/images/biometrics.png)

Both papers allow for heterogeneity in treatment versions across studies, which is common in the meta-analysis setting.\
\
Full-text can be found on arXiv :-)
